alignment.coordinate_convention: pixel centers: top-left (0,0), x right, y down; world x=x_min+px*resolution, y=y_min+(height-1-py)*resolution; scale JPG axes, rotate clockwise, translate center

topology.notes: IDs refer to odd JPG annotations; corresponding pmap IDs are +1. Guides expand search bounding boxes around bends only; they are not line vertices or mandatory waypoints. User explicitly requested 37-35 without 35-47, and entrance 19 to junction 47.

provenance.method: independent medial-axis geodesic; obstacle-checked straightening and quadratic corner rounding
provenance.guide_role: only expands route search bounds; does not create road vertices
